name: Forensic
description: The whole scene in cards: render setup, object states (hidden, not renderable, shadows off, invisible to camera, zero visibility, uncollapsed), totals, plugin objects, empty or broken geometry, animation layers and retimers, stacked Shell / repeated UVW Map, displacement, materials, CAD blocks and XRefs, unused helpers, empty layers, other-engine objects, missing files and plugins, and malicious scripts, each with Select and a one-click repair. Plus every modifier in the scene and the file's details.
author: OpenTools contributors
